test_scope: Independent behavior tests of workflow, parsing, repository, patch, state and evaluator boundaries. Fake provider only.
limitation: The isolated Platform fixture bypasses the package constructor; the release must separately validate package/foundation manifests and actual provider behavior.

findings.finding: Cancellation could append a file after evidence sealing, invalidating the completed receipt.
findings.remediation: Cancellation and finalization share a bounded-wait control lock; lock files are excluded from immutable evidence and cancellation is checked during sealing.

findings.finding: First control-lock revision used a nonblocking lock, so concurrent cancellation caused both finish and its failure handling to fail.
findings.remediation: Short control critical sections use bounded retry while the main worker lock remains nonblocking.

findings.finding: A partial terminal result could be resealed on resume without independently reconstructing its patch and acceptance evidence.
findings.remediation: Recovery recomputes selected output and checks semantic equality before sealing; unrecoverable terminal runs remain preserved and refused.

findings.finding: A .git/commondir regular file could redirect object and ref reads to a separate repository despite normal-repository-only policy.
findings.remediation: Repository reads now reject commondir, gitdir, alternate stores, HTTP alternates and graft metadata before invoking Git.
